notes.title: Development update and feedback demo
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45231352/e293c38e27d37f899926b064ef7ed019a86b5123.png

It's been a more than a few months since I've posted anywhere on the status of Brain Hack Squad and for that I am sorry. I plan to make updates are more regular occurrence in order to keep everyone up to date on the game's development. For now I have two things to share today....

First I have uploaded a short video on youtube, giving a basic rundown of the games core game play loop. Check it out.

[previewyoutube=JLsArsM9Sbg;full][/previewyoutube]

Second I have published a feedback demo on itch.io. Why do this? Why call it a feedback demo? Because I want to get some feedback from fans of the game and fans of Real Time Tactic games. It has some known issues, and the screen resolution is currently locked in the build, only allowing for windowed or full screen.

The current demo is only in English.

You can find the demo here... Brain Hack Squad Feedback demo.

The feedback form is linked to from inside the game, but you can also find it here... feedback form.
